description:
This protocol automates the setup of a qPCR reaction using the Opentrons robots. It scales with quantity of samples, but has a practical lower limit of 24 samples. This is a pythonized version of a Protocol Designer protocol.



Opentrons P300-single channel electronic pipettes (GEN2)
Opentrons P20-multi channel electronic pipettes (GEN2)
Opentrons 20ul Filter Tips
Opentrons 200ul Filter Tips
Opentrons Aluminum Block Set
